- Preserved history and report-only recoverable gardening

Tasks:
- [ ] PORTABLE-DOC-T006 Preserved history and report-only recoverable gardening
  - manifest: `task-manifests/PORTABLE-DOC-T006.yaml`
  - depends on: PORTABLE-DOC-T004
  - files: `scripts/amplai_docs.py`, `scripts/loopctl.py`, `scripts/loopv2.py`, `.ai-team/policy/gardening.json`, `.ai-team/knowledge/garden-report.schema.json`, `.ai-team/runtime/WORKFLOW.md`, `.ai-team/README.md`, `.agents/skills/work/`, `.agents/skills/dev-loop/`, `tools/amplai-loop-kit/`, `tests/ai/test_document_preservation.py`, `specs/012-portable-document-lifecycle/`

Acceptance:
- each unique REQUEST/SPEC/PLAN/memory claim maps to retained original or evidence-bound destination
- omitted unique invariant or incident lesson fails preservation completeness
- isolated fixture only: exact approved candidate, complete references, retention and verified backup permit staged recoverable retirement
- changed approval target/content/HEAD or unknown external reference rejects retirement
- user .bak files, retention holds, incidents and ADRs remain; generated cache candidates stay scoped
- age, zero static references or git history alone never authorizes removal
- normal work uses incremental gardening after docs/review; explicit full-cleanup Work is separate and any applied fixture change is reverified
- small UI change cannot trigger automatic whole-repository document deletion or unverified cleanup

Eval:
- `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/ai/test_document_preservation.py`

Dependencies:
- S04
